plan.direction: 4-hour univariate BTC/ETH time-series momentum with long/cash hysteresis; independent spot sleeves
plan.hypothesis: Medium-horizon crypto returns may exhibit time-series persistence; a positive trailing return enters long and a zero/negative reversal exits. Hysteresis thresholds limit repeated turnover. This is exploratory and not assumed profitable.

literature_context.citation: Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen (2012), Time series momentum, Journal of Financial Economics 104(2), 228-250
literature_context.scope: General trend-continuation motivation; not direct validation of BTC/ETH 4h spot.

literature_context.citation: Shen, Urquhart & Wang (2022), Bitcoin intraday time-series momentum, Financial Review 57, 319-344
literature_context.scope: Intraday BTC momentum literature context; this run does not reproduce its volume-clock rule.

data.source_interval: 1m OHLCV aggregated to UTC-aligned, fully closed 4h bars
data.history_note: This 2025-09-19..2026-09-14 window is reused development/evaluation history, not an untouched final holdout.

portfolio.meaning: One BTC sleeve with initial 1000 USDT and one ETH sleeve with initial 1000 USDT; no normalization, leverage, transfer or rebalancing across sleeves. Each sleeve is all-cash or long spot.

signal.bar_definition: UTC-aligned 4h bars aggregated from 240 fully closed Binance 1m bars; 4h bar close available at the next UTC 4h boundary.
signal.momentum: For completed bar index i, momentum_return = close[i]/close[i-L]-1 over exactly L completed 4h bars.
signal.entry: If flat, buy when momentum_return is strictly greater than entry_return_threshold_fraction.
signal.exit: If long, sell when momentum_return is less than or equal to exit_return_threshold_fraction. Exit rule has precedence. No shorting.
signal.state: Per-asset long/cash state carries continuously across contiguous folds; all sleeves begin in cash at the first OOS execution.
signal.execution: At signal availability on a UTC 4h boundary, use the following 1m bar open one minute later. Terminal positions are liquidated with costs at 2026-09-14T04:01:00Z.

parameter_grid.constraint: Every exit threshold is <= every entry threshold in the fixed grid.

plan.sensitivity_protocol: Full 3x3x3 grid; local neighbor uses at most one adjacent grid step on each of the three axes; no result-based selection.

cost_model.impact: 0.5 * sample stdev of the prior 20 complete UTC daily log returns * sqrt(order budget / mean prior 20 complete UTC daily quote ADV)
cost_model.rounding: PRICE_FILTER adverse tick rounding, LOT_SIZE quantity floor, NOTIONAL and PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE against prior-five-closed-minute VWAP proxy.
cost_model.limitations: No historical L2/queue position. Spread/slippage/impact and immediate full IOC are modeling assumptions, not exchange fill guarantees.

benchmark.source: recomputed in this round; exact same 4h OOS start/end and 1000USDT per asset.
benchmark.name: hold_360d_4h_BTC_ETH_50_50

history_audit.initial16: Prior artifact review found actual Freqtrade/research result evidence for all; no code-only missing initial row eligible for a fresh calculation.
history_audit.related_prior_study: research/experiments/20261012T100010Z tested 4h volume-confirmed momentum (lookbacks 6/12/24 plus slot-volume threshold); this plan tests univariate hysteresis thresholds and lookbacks 6/18/42 without that volume filter.
history_audit.selection_bias: Thousands of configurations and the same historical interval have been examined repeatedly.

data_manifest.source: Previously archived Binance spot 1m OHLCV; used for historical research only, not current forward paper trading.
